subject: Roadmap demo cascade & stacked windows — request to compress QBR + expansion walkthrough
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Morton <alyssa@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Roadmap demo cascade & stacked windows — request to compress QBR + expansion walkthrough

Hi Alyssa —

Hope you and the CloudWave team are doing well. As we get closer to your renewal, we wanted to propose a compressed cadence to cover the Renewal QBR and the expansion roadmap in one coordinated block. The goal is to keep exec time minimal while giving your engineers and product folks a hands-on slot.

Proposal (high level):
- 45 min: executive QBR (health, usage, KPIs)
- 60 min: roadmap + technical deep-dive (Marissa will own ops runbook)
- 30 min: optional hands-on lab (guided by Rishi / solutions)

We can stack these back-to-back or split across two adjacent days. Can you confirm which of the following works for your core attendees?
- Tue Jul 16, 9:00–11:00 PT (single-day compressed)
- Wed Jul 17, 13:00–15:00 PT (afternoon block + lab next day)
- Thu Jul 18, 08:30–10:30 PT (early window)

If none of these fit, send two 90-minute windows and we’ll flex. Also, who on your side should be invited for procurement/contract items (we’ll loop Rishi in for pricing options)?

Attaching the working agenda and a recommended stacked-demo route so your PMs can scan.

Thanks —
Diego
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alyssa Morton <alyssa@cloudwave.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jul 2029 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Roadmap demo cascade & stacked windows — request to compress QBR + expansion walkthrough

Diego —

Thanks for the clear options. Our execs prefer the single-day compressed option if we can keep it tight. Proposal from our side:
- Execs: Alyssa, Tom (CPO) — need the 45-min KPI + renewal snapshot only
- Eng/Product leads: Tom will bring two PMs (Sara + Minh) and our lead infra engineer (Priya) for the deeper technical segment

Can we shift the time slightly to 9:30–11:30 PT on Jul 16? That gives our east-coast folks a better start. If Rishi needs to be involved on pricing, loop him in — procurement may surface a few contract questions during the QBR.

Also — we’d like the hands-on lab recorded (if possible) and a short follow-up playbook after the session.

Alyssa
Dir. of Product Ops | CloudWave
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Morton <alyssa@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jul 2029 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Roadmap demo cascade & stacked windows — request to compress QBR + expansion walkthrough

Perfect — 9:30–11:30 PT on Jul 16 is fine. I’ve tentatively held that slot and will send a calendar invite after we lock attendees.

Marissa — can you own the run of show and the recording consent? Key ops asks from CloudWave: recorded lab, short playbook after (we’ll include next steps and recommended config changes).

Rishi — Alyssa flagged procurement questions; would you confirm what pricing artifacts we should bring to the QBR and whether we can surface a simple three-tier pricing snapshot for the expansion? Deal id is CW-2029-REN-7841.

Diego
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Alyssa Morton <alyssa@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jul 2029 12:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Roadmap demo cascade & stacked windows — request to compress QBR + expansion walkthrough

Thanks — I’ll prepare a concise pricing appendix for the QBR (one-slide summary + backup table). For CW-2029-REN-7841 I’ll include:
- Current committed usage + projected delta for expansion
- Three quick configurations: Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive (cost and latency tradeoffs)
- Suggested contract cadence and renewal timeline (we can discuss credits or short-term top-up if needed)

Marissa — can you confirm whether we have capacity to run a live hands-on lab for up to 6 external participants that day? If not, propose a recorded demo with interactive Q&A.

Alyssa — quick ask: will your legal/procurement team be on the call or do you prefer a separate procurement touchpoint after the QBR?

—Rishi
VP, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Morton <alyssa@cloudwave.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jul 2029 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Roadmap demo cascade & stacked windows — request to compress QBR + expansion walkthrough

Hi team —

We have capacity for a short live lab (up to 6 seats) but recommend a hybrid approach to avoid timeouts: live lab for the infra lead + PMs, plus a recorded guided run for broader attendees. I’ll prepare:
- A 3-step runbook for the lab (10–15 minute tasks)
- A recording & short summary playbook within 24 hours of the session
- Consent language for recording (I’ll include in the invite)

I’ll draft the invite and include the recording consent + a pre-read with the focused agenda. Diego — if you can confirm attendees today I’ll finalize the calendar and share the Drive folder (attached).

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: QBR_Agenda_v3.pdf (agenda)
From: Alyssa Morton <alyssa@cloudwave.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jul 2029 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Roadmap demo cascade & stacked windows — request to compress QBR + expansion walkthrough

Diego / Marissa / Rishi —

Confirmed attendees: Alyssa, Tom (CPO), Sara Kim (PM), Minh Tran (PM), Priya N. (Lead Infra). Legal is not joining the QBR; procurement will follow up after the session if needed.

9:30–11:30 PT on Jul 16 works — please send the calendar invite with the recording consent and the pre-read. We prefer the live lab be focused on Priya + Sara; others can watch the recording.

Thanks — looking forward.
Alyssa

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudwave-qbr-20290716
